visuals.purpose: 为 AI Core 工厂类比提供章节引入画面
visuals.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Chinese Ascend C tutorial chapter-opening decorative illustration
Primary request: an abstract modern factory metaphor for coordinated computation, with separate glowing work zones and streams of small material blocks moving smoothly between them
Scene/backdrop: spacious dark teal workshop-like abstract environment, clean and minimal
Subject: geometric work zones, conveyors, and light trails as a metaphor only, not a hardware diagram
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D illustration with soft depth and precise geometry
Composition/framing: wide landscape, balanced flow from input through work zones to output, generous margins
Lighting/mood: teal, jade, and restrained coral highlights, orderly and optimistic
Constraints: decorative only; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no recognizable processor, no labeled components, no technical architecture claims
Avoid: infographic layout, semantic labels, branded hardware, realistic factory workers, dense clutter
